description: This Java source file defines the CustomerController class, a REST controller for managing Customer entities in the Thingsboard platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting customers, as well as fetching customer lists with pagination and filtering.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: REST controller for Customer management, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and list retrieval.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer by its ID.

methods.name: getShortCustomerInfoById
methods.description: Returns a short info JSON with title and isPublic flag for a Customer.

methods.name: getCustomerTitleById
methods.description: Returns the title of a Customer.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Creates or updates a Customer entity.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a Customer by its ID.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Customers owned by the tenant.

methods.name: getTenantCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer by its title within the tenant.

methods.name: getCustomersByIdsV1
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customers by their UUIDs (internal use).

methods.name: getCustomersByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customers by their UUIDs.
